name: BACH_0374
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (90%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged (tier 3) for low reliability (46%) and foundation-model disagreement; H&E recut and deeper levels are drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 90%, InSitu 8%, Normal 2%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%) [F1] | Strong Benign score; negligible invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 46% reliability (flagged), 88% OOD, 12 regions kept [F6] | Suspect input; error AUROC is 70% |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%) [F5]; closest is Normal (90% similarity) | Mixed neighbors; nearest case is Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.14; contribution -0.66) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.30; contribution -0.47) favors duct-confined growth [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.97; contribution -0.35), failed 0/20 spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 6, 9, 10) · context · 91% neoplastic nuclei [F7], 4,703/mm² [F8] (100th percentiles); 92% TIL proximity [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); case leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Dense neoplastic nuclei (91%, regions 6, 9, 10) and duct-confined atypia (regions 1, 9, 11) represent InSitu (8%).
- Atypical section quality (46% reliability, 88% OOD) masks diagnostic features, requiring the drafted H&E recut or deeper levels.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 9, 10**: Inspect region 10 (19% invasive risk) and dense neoplastic nuclei (200–229/region) to exclude InSitu.
2. **Regions 1, 9, 11**: Verify whether atypical duct-confined cells represent benign proliferation or InSitu (8% probability).
3. **Regions 0, 4**: Check lobules and stroma directly (unreliable 0/20 lobule concept) and assess need for recut/deeper levels.
